segments.title: New Tab stays on top
segments.body: With new tabs at the top, New Tab keeps its place above the list once the list fills the sidebar. It used to drop to the bottom.

segments.title: Groups step in
segments.body: A group's tabs sit indented under its header, and a tab gives a little when you press it.

segments.title: Search a collapsed group
segments.body: Hover a collapsed group to see all its tabs, most recent first, and type to find one. It used to list the first eight.

segments.title: Downloads by their button
segments.body: The panel opens under the button you clicked, with an arrow, and the page shows through it.

segments.title: The page holds still
segments.body: While the ardia command works, a pill floats over the page. Before, a bar pushed the page down on every command.

segments.title: Extensions by name
segments.body: Type an extension's name in the command bar to open it or its options.

segments.title: Open Page in WebKit
segments.body: A page that asks for Apple's FairPlay DRM gets an offer to reload in WebKit, which has it. Chromium in Ardia doesn't.
